name: Bufferium
description: Bufferium V1.00 - in-game F7 panel for the predictive input buffer: on/off checkbox, strength chips, live console buttons.

toggle-key.name: Panel key
toggle-key.description: Key that shows/hides the Bufferium panel inside a level. Change this if F7 does nothing for you (laptop Fn keys, key used by another mod).
